c11_orig.cat.meaning: C++11/C++20 without po|rf acyclicity permits load-buffering / out-of-thin-air cycle 0:r0=1 /\ 1:r1=1

rc11.cat.meaning: RC11 acyclic(po | rf) forbids LB-data cycle at the cost of forbidding load-to-store reordering on relaxed atomics
Seqlock reader using relaxed atomic payload loads + acquire fence before second sequence load is race-free and never observes torn payload (1:r1=1 /\ 1:r2=0) when 1:s1=0 /\ 1:s2=0
Seqlock reader using non-atomic payload read (*d1) triggers data-race UB (Undef) in C++20/RC11 even when followed by an acquire fence and retry loop

aarch64.cat -variant mixed.meaning: Two 1-byte stores (STRB) followed by STLR flag are ordered before a 2-byte mixed-size read (LDRH) after LDAR flag under herd7 mixed-size AArch64

x86_64 -variant mixed.meaning: Mixed-size store-buffer forwarding (1-byte movb $1,(x) forwarded into 2-byte movw (x),%bx) on x86-64
